threads.body: I guess an alternative would be to se an internal interface

replies.body: Similar to https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-java-instrumentation/pull/16304#discussion_r2872999173, I kind of like making it public to support anyone outside of this repo going through the transition, although maybe that's not too realistic since they'd have to stick to our timeline as we'll be removing them in 3.0
